title: Set the screen timeout in Settings

setup.why: Keep the phone's own timeout once (a retried setup keeps the first copy), so teardown puts it back.
Start from a different timeout, so the agent has to change it.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: Using the Settings app, make the screen turn off after {{t.say}} of inactivity.

checks.why: Settings writes the chosen timeout to system/screen_off_timeout in milliseconds; {{t.say}} is {{t.want}}. Setup left {{t.start}}, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Put the phone's own timeout back when it was a number, and drop the saved copy.

argv: f=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}.orig; v=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null); case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) settings put system screen_off_timeout $v ;; esac; rm -f $f
